title: Verify both bounded-range wrapper prefixes
changes: Compare both original range-reader wrapper prefixes through the helper return against E170 typed reads, covering each recorded bound and an unmatched value.
validation: Windows GNU build bounded-range-wrapper-build-efo9lv8n and Wine bounded-range-wrapper-wine-xfsk4jgx pass 92 controlled cases: two wrappers, 23 values and interpreter/generated instruction-block dispatch. Full machine state and clock match, all 88 source bytes are altered, and unmatched outputs retain sentinels. Protected inputs pass, scratch is removed and Wine drains.
limitations: The cases stop before the subsequent rendering calls and do not establish ordinary execution of upstream callers, full input domains, production cache selection, legacy cross-mode IRQ equivalence, Linux, USA, native Windows or performance. Generated blocks may fall back to interpretation.
